# Do Not Service Tag

Apply this tag to prevent any future scheduling for a customer.

# FAQs

**Does this cancel existing jobs?**

No, existing scheduled jobs are left untouched.

**Can I remove the tag later?**

Yes, remove it from the customer record at any time.
